mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates and reducing risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the CPI index above 207.5 signals accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 207.5, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5) indicates a tight monetary policy and weak labor market, which together signal a high probability of recession and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 AND UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC between interaction of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE and 20d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 0.5% or greater increase in FEDFUNDS over the last 3 months), a higher level of the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS increase >= 0.5% over last 3 months, or Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1500.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0, or Rank IC between HOUST and 60d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the industrial sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 60d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 137000.0 thousand persons signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 137000.0, or Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5d returns is >= 0 over any 3-year rolling window.
